keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across the recall title and product description (e.g. "stroller", "space heater", "button battery"). Leave blank to skip keyword filtering.

hazard.title: Hazard
hazard.description: Free-text search across the described hazard (e.g. "fire", "choking", "laceration"). Leave blank to skip hazard filtering.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer or brand
manufacturer.description: Free-text search across manufacturer/importer/distributor names. Leave blank to skip.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, based on the recall's publish date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of recalls to return, most recent first.
